text:
alex: hi all — first day! trying to switch to the staging context and `kubectl get svc -n staging` fails with Forbidden.
Error from server (Forbidden): services is forbidden: User "alex" cannot list resource "services" in API group "" in the namespace "staging". anyone seen this when using teleport kube access?

jamie: welcome :wave: can you paste `kubectl config current-context` and the kubeconfig path (are you using Teleport's generated kubeconfig or a merged ~/.kube/config)?

alex: current-context: `teleport-staging`. kubeconfig is `~/.kube/teleport.yaml` (tsh wrote it).

teleport-bot: Note: Teleport kubeaccess grants are derived from your SSO groups at login. If groups changed, run `tsh login --proxy=teleport.redwood.com --force` to refresh.

dev-infra: quick checks: run `kubectl auth can-i list services -n staging --as=alex` and `kubectl auth can-i list services -n staging` (the second checks your current creds). paste both outputs.

alex: first `kubectl auth can-i` (explicit): returns `no`. second (current): returns `no` as well.

samir: sounds like your SSO groups aren't mapped to a k8s RoleBinding in staging. We map the SSO group `redwood-engineers` to view in staging. Can you check your groups token claim? `tsh tokens` or `jwt decode` isn't convenient for everyone, but run `tsh status` to confirm which groups arrived.

alex: `tsh status` shows groups: ["all", "newhires"], not `redwood-engineers`. hmm.

jamie: that's the issue then. Usually infra updates group membership in IdP, then you re-login. If your account isn't in `redwood-engineers` yet, infra can add you. Short-term we can create a rolebinding for your user.

dev-infra: I can create a short-lived RoleBinding. Command I will run: `kubectl create rolebinding onboarding-alex-view --clusterrole=view --user=alex -n staging` (expires in 4h; audited). Please open INF ticket so we track permanent access.

devex: FYI — policy: we never make permanent user rolebindings for groups; prefer group->role mapping. Use infra-access template: https://intra.redwood.com/infra-access-requests. Tag `#devex` and `#eng-oncall`.

teleport-bot: Audit: RoleBinding `onboarding-alex-view` created by dev-infra; TTL 4h; ticket INF-6001.

alex: i can list services now, thank you!! :tada: one more Q: our CI uses `staging-deploy` SA for deployments — do I need to get that SA write perms or is it separate?

samir: CI serviceaccounts are separate. If the pipeline needs to apply manifests, the `staging-deploy` SA needs `edit` in the namespace. Open the ticket and include CI owner and repo so we can scope it correctly.

jamie: welcome to the team, @alex — we'll follow up on INF-6001 and ensure your IdP groups are updated so re-login fixes this long-term. If anything else blocks onboarding ping us here.

alex: great, thanks everyone!
